LanguageData.FB_AcceptanceOfFleshColony.description: Mind and body are linked to the flesh colony. Pain is dulled and the needs for comfort, beauty, recreation, and time outdoors disappear, but social, animal handling, and artistic aptitudes decline. Wounds heal faster, immunity develops more quickly, and old scars gradually fade. Tendrils of the shared network emerge across the skin.
LanguageData.FB_AcceptanceOfFleshColony.label: flesh-colony acceptance
LanguageData.FB_FleshbeastHealingComa.description: The colony flesh immobilizes this creature while sealing and tending its open wounds. The injuries remain and must heal naturally afterward.
LanguageData.FB_FleshbeastHealingComa.label: fleshbeast healing torpor
LanguageData.FB_FleshbeastHealingComa.stages.0.label: healing torpor
LanguageData.FB_FleshInstability.description: This body is still stabilizing after violent division or fragmentation. Until the instability fades, the host cannot split again.
LanguageData.FB_FleshInstability.label: flesh instability
LanguageData.FB_FleshInstability.stages.0.label: residual instability
LanguageData.FB_FleshInstability.stages.1.label: stabilizing flesh
LanguageData.FB_FleshInstability.stages.2.label: acute instability
LanguageData.FB_FunSpores.label: fun spores
LanguageData.FB_FunSpores.stages.0.label: initial exposure
LanguageData.FB_FunSpores.stages.1.label: mild exposure
LanguageData.FB_FunSpores.stages.2.label: moderate exposure
LanguageData.FB_FunSpores.stages.3.label: strong exposure
LanguageData.FB_GeneticFatigue.description: A consequence of gene extraction that temporarily reduces consciousness and blood filtration. It resolves on its own after two days.
LanguageData.FB_GeneticFatigue.label: genetic fatigue
LanguageData.FB_GraftmawSurgicalStasis.description: The target is pinned in place by living surgical tendrils and cannot resist the current procedure.
LanguageData.FB_GraftmawSurgicalStasis.label: graftmaw surgical stasis
LanguageData.FB_LivingWeaponBondOwner.description: This colonist is psychically linked to one or more living weapons.
LanguageData.FB_LivingWeaponBondOwner.label: living weapon bond
LanguageData.FB_LivingWeaponBondWeapon.description: This living weapon recognizes a single bonded wielder.
LanguageData.FB_LivingWeaponBondWeapon.label: bonded wielder
LanguageData.FB_NerveclotResonance.description: Neural resonance speeds movement, reduces incoming damage, and accelerates wound healing. It also repairs damaged tissue while active.
LanguageData.FB_NerveclotResonance.label: nerveclot resonance
LanguageData.FB_NeuralStatic.description: Neural interference reduces shooting accuracy, slows aiming, increases fatigue, and raises the risk of a mental break.
LanguageData.FB_NeuralStatic.label: neural static
LanguageData.FB_OrganicArmor_Head.description: Bone plates on the head increase the host's protection. Dense armor impedes movement, and its densest stage can cause vomiting. The plates break down over time.
LanguageData.FB_OrganicArmor_Head.label: head organic armor
LanguageData.FB_OrganicArmor_Head.stages.0.label: brittle armor
LanguageData.FB_OrganicArmor_Head.stages.1.label: deteriorating armor
LanguageData.FB_OrganicArmor_Head.stages.2.label: dense armor
LanguageData.FB_OrganicArmor_Torso.description: Bony growths on the torso increase the host's protection. Dense armor impedes movement, and its densest stage can cause vomiting. The growths break down over time.
LanguageData.FB_OrganicArmor_Torso.label: torso organic armor
LanguageData.FB_OrganicArmor_Torso.stages.0.label: brittle armor
LanguageData.FB_OrganicArmor_Torso.stages.1.label: deteriorating armor
LanguageData.FB_OrganicArmor_Torso.stages.2.label: dense armor
LanguageData.FB_Parasite.label: parasite
LanguageData.FB_Parasite.stages.0.label: early-stage
LanguageData.FB_Parasite.stages.1.label: middle-stage
LanguageData.FB_Parasite.stages.2.label: late-stage
LanguageData.FB_PersonalityParasite.description: The parasite has fused with the brain and preserves its host's personality, suppressing pain while gradually exhausting the body to the point of death. After the host dies, it leaves the body and can transfer the stored mind into a suitable corpse.
LanguageData.FB_PersonalityParasite.label: personality parasite
LanguageData.FB_PersonalityParasite.stages.0.label: parasite integration
LanguageData.FB_PersonalityParasite.stages.1.label: early depletion
LanguageData.FB_PersonalityParasite.stages.2.label: progressive depletion
LanguageData.FB_PersonalityParasite.stages.3.label: Advanced Depletion
LanguageData.FB_PersonalityParasite.stages.4.label: critical depletion
LanguageData.FB_PersonalityParasite.stages.5.label: Death
LanguageData.FB_PoisonousSpores.label: poisonous spores
LanguageData.FB_PoisonousSpores.stages.0.label: initial exposure
LanguageData.FB_PoisonousSpores.stages.1.label: light infection
LanguageData.FB_PoisonousSpores.stages.2.label: moderate infection
LanguageData.FB_PoisonousSpores.stages.3.label: severe infection
LanguageData.FB_ResurrectionShock.description: A consequence of resurrection that causes pain, reduced consciousness, and impaired movement, manipulation, and circulation. It resolves on its own after three days.
LanguageData.FB_ResurrectionShock.label: resurrection shock
LanguageData.FB_SinewcallerBeckoned.description: A psychic call suppresses the animal's wariness and compels it to follow the sinewcaller.
LanguageData.FB_SinewcallerBeckoned.label: beckoned by flesh
LanguageData.FB_SporeAnesthesia.description: The spores dull pain and reduce consciousness. Strong exposure renders the host unconscious. The effect gradually fades without further exposure.
LanguageData.FB_SporeAnesthesia.label: spore anesthesia
LanguageData.FB_SporeAnesthesia.stages.0.label: initial exposure
LanguageData.FB_SporeAnesthesia.stages.1.label: drowsy
LanguageData.FB_SporeAnesthesia.stages.2.label: unconscious
LanguageData.FB_SporeGrowths.description: Spore growths release clouds of toxic, euphoric, or sedating spores. The spore type can be selected, and emission can be enabled or disabled.
LanguageData.FB_SporeGrowths.label: spore growths
LanguageData.FB_ThrallbloomNeuralLink.description: The mind is controlled by a thrallbloom. When the link breaks, the victim returns to their original faction and remains disoriented for a time. Three days of uninterrupted control destroy the victim's mind and cause death.
LanguageData.FB_ThrallbloomNeuralLink.label: neural thrall link
LanguageData.FB_PoisonousSpores.description: Toxic spores reduce consciousness and mobility, impair coordination, and corrode tissues. Without further exposure, the spore burden gradually decreases.
LanguageData.FB_FunSpores.description: The spores cause growing euphoria and improve mood. Strong exposure reduces consciousness. The effect gradually fades without further doses.
LanguageData.FB_Parasite.description: A hostile flesh parasite matures inside the host. Once mature, it can be called out of a living host or corpse, and it bursts out automatically if the host dies.
LanguageData.FB_TriTendrilsGrowth.description: Three muscular tendrils have grown from the torso, delivering blunt strikes in melee combat.
LanguageData.FB_TriTendrilsGrowth.label: tri-tendrils
LanguageData.FB_DorsalSpinesGrowth.description: Two spine-tendrils protrude from this pawn's back. Each one can jab forward in close combat.
LanguageData.FB_DorsalSpinesGrowth.label: dorsal spike pair
LanguageData.FB_MeatBloomGrowth.description: This pawn is constantly growing loose edible flesh. The new tissue pulls extra nutrition from the body until it sloughs away.
LanguageData.FB_MeatBloomGrowth.label: meat bloom
LanguageData.FB_BloodTendrilChanneling.description: This pawn is rooted in place while a blood tendril pumps stolen blood back into the body.
LanguageData.FB_BloodTendrilOrgan.description: A specialized organic tendril embedded in the throat. This flexible, muscular organ can extend outward through the mouth, latch onto a distant target, and extract blood.
LanguageData.FB_BloodTendrilLatched.description: A blood tendril is hooked into this body, pinning it in place while it drains blood.
LanguageData.FB_BloodTendrilChanneling.label: blood tendril channeling
LanguageData.FB_BloodTendrilLatched.label: blood tendril latch
LanguageData.FB_BloodTendrilOrgan.label: blood tendril
LanguageData.FB_NeuralOverheat.label: neural overheat
LanguageData.FB_NeuralOverheat.description: Residual neural heat accumulated while a pawn is used for accelerated research. Reaching full severity burns the brain and resets the accumulated heat. Outside the synapse core, it gradually dissipates over one day.
LanguageData.FB_FerrimawMetalMetabolismPaused.label: dormant ferric gut
LanguageData.FB_FerrimawMetalMetabolismPaused.descrip: The ferrimaw's metal metabolism is dormant, suppressing hunger until it is allowed to consume stored metal again.
LanguageData.FB_DecentralizedOrganism.description: The host's vital systems are no longer concentrated in individual organs. A distributed mass of colony flesh can tear itself into two younger bodies at the moment of death, then rebuild toward adulthood at extreme speed.
LanguageData.FB_DecentralizedOrganism.label: decentralized organism
LanguageData.FB_DecentralizedOrganism.stages.0.label: distributed flesh
LanguageData.FB_DecentralizedFleshTorso.description: The torso has been replaced by a distributed mass of thinking muscle and redundant organs. The original limbs and organs are no longer separate vital systems.
LanguageData.FB_DecentralizedFleshTorso.label: decentralized fleshmass
LanguageData.FB_DecentralizedFleshHead.description: The head has become a replaceable knot of sensory flesh. Sight, hearing, speech, and thought are distributed through the organism instead of relying on fragile human organs.
LanguageData.FB_DecentralizedFleshHead.label: distributed sensor node
